scheme_long_name: USDA Harmonized Good Agricultural Practices - Field Operations and Harvesting
source_document: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Standard v3.1 + Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2 (xlsx/pdf), effective 2025-07-03
license_note: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP checklist text is U.S. government work and not subject to copyright. Operational paraphrasing in this ruleset is provided for product implementation; for audit-of-record use the canonical USDA AMS source document referenced in source_url.

control_point.title: short imperative summary
control_point.description: operational paraphrase of what the control requires
control_point.evidence_required: boolean - whether at least one evidence artifact must be linked to mark this control met
control_point.expert_review_required: boolean - whether a GAP expert (not just the farmer) must sign off

evidence_spec.guidance: concrete description of the artifact a farmer/worker should provide

references.label: free-text citation to the source standard
references.locator: e.g. AMS HGAP G-1.1, page reference, or section number

control_point.ams_ids: array of verbatim USDA AMS HGAP control identifiers (e.g. ["G-2.1"]). Empty array = SmartFarm-added with no direct AMS analogue.
control_point.ams_mapping_note: optional string explaining bundling, divergence, or SmartFarm additions when the mapping is non-trivial.

evidence_kind_vocabulary.photo: Image captured in the field; geotag and timestamp preferred but not required at v1.
evidence_kind_vocabulary.document: Uploaded file (PDF, image scan, spreadsheet, signed form). Source-of-truth artifact.
evidence_kind_vocabulary.note: Free-text statement attested by the user; lowest evidentiary weight, often paired with another kind.
evidence_kind_vocabulary.measurement: Numeric reading with unit and timestamp (e.g. water test ppm, refrigeration temperature).
evidence_kind_vocabulary.log_record: Structured row in an in-app log (e.g. training attendance, sanitation cleaning, pesticide application).

controls.subsection: Land Use History and Risk Assessment
controls.title: Prior land use risk assessment for each production block
controls.description: For each field/block, a documented assessment evaluates prior land use (livestock, dumping, flooding, industrial) and any required mitigations before planting.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the land-use history assessment per block, with sources consulted.
Reviewer note confirming mitigations (if any) are appropriate.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-1.1
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-1.1.a
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-1.1.b

controls.ams_mapping_note: Field history risk assessment (F-1.1), per-block risk assessment pre-harvest (F-1.1.a), control measures (F-1.1.b).

controls.subsection: Land Use History and Risk Assessment
controls.title: Adjacent land risk assessment
controls.description: Adjacent land uses (livestock operations, water bodies, septic, industrial) are assessed for potential contamination risk and documented mitigations are in place.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload an aerial map of each block annotated with adjacent land uses within ~400 ft.
Documented mitigations such as buffer strips, fencing, or drainage diversions.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-1.1

controls.ams_mapping_note: Adjacent land risk is part of F-1.1 evaluation, not a separate AMS control.

controls.title: Water source identified and risk-assessed
controls.description: Each water source used for production (irrigation, frost protection, agrochemical mixing) is identified, mapped, and risk-assessed for type and protection level.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload water source map and source-type description (well, surface, municipal, reclaimed).
Upload the water source risk assessment for each source.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-2.1
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-2.2
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-2.3

controls.ams_mapping_note: Water system description (F-2.1), regulatory compliance (F-2.2), no cross-connection (F-2.3).

controls.title: Pre-season and in-season microbial water testing
controls.description: Agricultural water used in a way that contacts the harvestable portion is tested for generic E. coli at the frequency required by the source type, with results meeting scheme thresholds.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload accredited lab water test reports for the season.
Enter each test result: source id, sample date, generic E. coli MPN/100mL, lab id.
If any result exceeded the threshold, attach the corrective action record.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-3.1
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-4.2
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-4.3

controls.ams_mapping_note: Water risk assessment (F-3.1), testing per plan (F-4.2), implementation (F-4.3).

controls.title: Water distribution system inspected and maintained
controls.description: Irrigation lines, pumps, filters, and backflow prevention devices are inspected on a documented schedule and maintained to prevent contamination.

evidence_spec.guidance: Inspection/maintenance log entries with date, asset, finding, action.
Optional photos of backflow preventers and filter assemblies in current condition.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-4.1
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-9.5

controls.ams_mapping_note: Water management plan (F-4.1) + delivery system condition (F-9.5).

controls.title: Commodity-specific water testing exceptions documented
controls.description: Where a commodity, water source, or application method qualifies for an exception or modified testing frequency under the scheme (e.g. drip irrigation on commodities not normally consumed raw), the exception is documented with the rationale and evidence supporting eligibility.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the documented exception decision: commodity, water source, application method, scheme citation, decision date, signer.
Reviewer note confirming the exception aligns with scheme/regulatory text.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-4.6

controls.ams_mapping_note: Alternative approaches to regulatory water testing (F-4.6) covers crop-specific exceptions.

controls.title: Soil amendment inventory and risk classification
controls.description: All soil amendments (composts, manures, fertilizers) are inventoried with source, type, treatment status (raw, composted, processed), and intended application areas.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the soil amendment inventory listing all materials used in the season.
For composted/processed amendments, upload supplier certificate of analysis or process documentation.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-6.1

controls.title: Untreated biological amendment intervals respected
controls.description: If untreated or partially treated biological soil amendments of animal origin are used, the documented application-to-harvest interval meets scheme/FSMA requirements for the crop.

evidence_spec.guidance: Application log: amendment id, block, application date, planned harvest date, interval (days).
Reviewer note confirming interval policy is documented if untreated amendments are used.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-6.2

controls.title: Pesticide application records
controls.description: Each pesticide application is recorded with product, EPA reg number, rate, target pest, applicator, weather, REI, and PHI; records are signed by the applicator.

evidence_spec.guidance: Pesticide application log per event - all required fields populated.
Upload current applicator licenses for personnel making restricted-use applications.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, G-11.1
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, G-11.3

controls.ams_mapping_note: AMS places pesticide application in General (G-11). Application records derive from G-11.1 label compliance + G-11.3 trained applicators.

controls.title: Pre-harvest interval respected
controls.description: Harvest does not occur within a product's pre-harvest interval; system enforces or alerts on conflicts between application date and planned harvest date.

evidence_spec.guidance: Cross-reference of application log and harvest log per block showing interval respected.
If any PHI conflict occurred, attach the corrective action and disposition decision.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, G-11.1

controls.ams_mapping_note: PHI compliance is part of label compliance under G-11.1.

controls.title: Pesticide storage and mixing area controls
controls.description: Pesticides are stored in a secured, ventilated, signed area separate from food-contact materials; mixing/loading occurs in a designated area with spill-containment provisions.

evidence_spec.guidance: Photos of pesticide storage area showing security, signage, ventilation, and separation.
Photo of mix/load area with spill containment.
Upload spill response procedure for the mix/load area.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, G-11.6.a

controls.ams_mapping_note: Storage of crop-approved vs. non-crop chemicals separately (G-11.6.a). G-11.6 covers disposal.

controls.title: Application equipment calibrated on documented schedule
controls.description: Pesticide and fertilizer application equipment is calibrated on a documented schedule and after major maintenance, with calibration records retained.

evidence_spec.guidance: Calibration log per equipment id: date, calibrator, method, result.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-7.2.a
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-7.2.b

controls.ams_mapping_note: Equipment calibration (F-7.2.a) + traceable calibration standard (F-7.2.b).

controls.title: Pre-harvest wildlife/animal intrusion inspection
controls.description: Each block is inspected for animal intrusion or fecal contamination immediately before harvest; observations and any no-harvest buffers are documented.

evidence_spec.guidance: Pre-harvest inspection record per block: date, inspector, observations, action taken.
If contamination observed, photo of the affected area and any flag/buffer placed.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-5.1
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-5.2
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-8.1

controls.ams_mapping_note: Animal-activity risk assessment (F-5.1), routine monitoring (F-5.2), preharvest risk assessment (F-8.1).

controls.title: Documented re-entry/release of buffered areas after contamination event
controls.description: When an area is excluded from harvest due to animal intrusion, contamination, or other event, a documented re-entry decision (or permanent disposition) is recorded by an authorized reviewer before harvest resumes in that area.

evidence_spec.guidance: Exclusion-and-release log: block id, exclusion date, reason, area, release date, decision-maker.
Optional supporting evidence (re-inspection record, lab result, photo timeline).

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-5.3

controls.ams_mapping_note: Measures to prevent contamination based on animal-activity assessment (F-5.3).

controls.title: Harvest worker hygiene practices verified
controls.description: Harvest crew follows documented hygiene practices (handwashing on entry/return, glove use as applicable, jewelry policy, no eating in field areas); supervisor verifies daily.

evidence_spec.guidance: Daily harvest hygiene checklist signed by supervisor.
Optional photo of harvest crew start-of-day handwashing station setup.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, G-10.1
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, G-10.6
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, G-10.8
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, G-10.16

controls.ams_mapping_note: Hygiene policy (G-10.1), facility cleanliness (G-10.6), handwashing (G-10.8), prohibited behaviors in handling areas (G-10.16).

controls.title: Harvest containers and food-contact surfaces sanitation
controls.description: Harvest bins, totes, knives, and other food-contact surfaces are cleaned and sanitized on a documented schedule; damaged or contaminated containers are removed from service.

evidence_spec.guidance: Container/equipment cleaning and sanitation log: date, equipment, chemical/concentration, signer.
Photo of clean storage area for sanitized containers.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-7.1
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-7.2

controls.ams_mapping_note: Equipment cleanliness (F-7.1) + good repair / cleaned (F-7.2).

controls.title: Foreign material control during harvest
controls.description: A documented procedure addresses glass, hard plastic, metal, and personal item controls during harvest; broken-glass policy and exclusion of personal items from harvest area are enforced.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the foreign material control SOP including broken-glass response.
Foreign material incident log (may be empty if none in period).

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-7.4
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-11.3

controls.ams_mapping_note: Equipment as physical-hazard source (F-7.4) + harvest inspection for physical hazards (F-11.3).

controls.title: Water and ice used during harvest meets potability requirements
controls.description: Any water or ice used during harvest that contacts produce or food-contact surfaces is potable; potability is documented through source qualification and routine testing where required.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload water/ice source description and potability documentation (municipal report, well test, or supplier certificate).
Routine test results for harvest-use water (e.g. coliform, sanitizer concentration if applicable).

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-9.1
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-9.2
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-9.3

controls.ams_mapping_note: Harvest water procedures (F-9.1), microbial quality (F-9.2), antimicrobial treatment (F-9.3).

controls.title: Field packaging materials are food-grade and stored protected
controls.description: Cartons, liners, clamshells, and other primary packaging used in the field are food-grade, stored off the ground and protected from contamination, pests, and weather between use.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload supplier food-grade certification / spec sheet for packaging materials in use.
Photo of in-field packaging storage showing pallets, covers, and protection.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-11.5
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-11.6
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-11.7

controls.ams_mapping_note: Packaging fit-for-use (F-11.5), stored to minimize contamination (F-11.6), policy on direct soil contact (F-11.7).

controls.title: Visibly contaminated or decayed produce is culled from harvest
controls.description: The operation has a written harvest rule that visibly contaminated, damaged, or decayed produce is not harvested for sale, or is immediately culled from product intended for sale.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the harvest SOP or crew instruction stating that visibly contaminated, damaged, or decayed produce is not harvested or is culled.
Crew training or supervisor verification record showing the rule was communicated for the current season.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-11.1

controls.title: Ground-contact produce is not harvested unless normal for the crop
controls.description: Produce that contacted the ground is not harvested unless ground contact is normal for that commodity and the operation has defined the acceptable handling practice for that crop.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the harvest policy describing the ground-contact rule and any commodity-specific exception.
Supervisor or harvest checklist record showing the ground-contact rule was checked during harvest.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-11.2

controls.title: Harvest lot coding applied at point of harvest
controls.description: Each harvested lot is assigned a unique code at the point of harvest tying it to field/block, harvest date, and crew, enabling traceability per G-4.1.

evidence_spec.guidance: Harvest log with lot code per harvest event.
Photo of representative lot tag/label as applied to a bin or pallet.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-11.8.a
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, G-6.1

controls.ams_mapping_note: Product release procedure (F-11.8.a) + traceability program (G-6.1).

controls.title: Field toilet and handwashing placement and counts
controls.description: Field toilets and handwashing units are provided in compliance with applicable labor law ratios (e.g. one per 20 workers, within a quarter-mile), and serviced on a documented schedule.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload field map showing locations of toilets/handwash units relative to crews.
Servicing/cleaning log from the provider.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, G-10.4
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, G-10.6

controls.ams_mapping_note: Toilet accessibility (G-10.4) + clean condition (G-10.6). AMS leaves count/placement to "easily accessible" + prevailing regulation.

controls.title: Sewage/wastewater spill response procedure
controls.description: A documented procedure exists for handling sewage spills from field toilets, including no-harvest buffer determination and product disposition.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the sewage spill response SOP.
Spill response log entries (may be empty).

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, G-10.7

controls.title: Field transport vehicles inspected and clean
controls.description: Vehicles transporting harvested product from the field are inspected for cleanliness and absence of contaminants before loading, with results recorded.

evidence_spec.guidance: Transport pre-load inspection log: date, vehicle id, inspector, condition, action.
Optional photo of cleaned trailer/bed before loading.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-13.1
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-13.2

controls.ams_mapping_note: Shipping equipment cleanliness checklist (F-13.1) + load/unload damage prevention (F-13.2).

controls.title: Field/initial cooling temperature monitoring (if applicable)
controls.description: If field cooling or initial cooling occurs as part of field operations, target temperatures are defined per commodity and monitored with calibrated devices, with deviations recorded.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the cooling SOP with commodity-specific target temperatures.
Cooling temperature readings: lot, time, temperature, instrument id.
Upload most recent thermometer calibration record.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-12.1
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-12.1.a

controls.ams_mapping_note: Post-harvest handling not contaminated (F-12.1) + clean field-pack collection points (F-12.1.a). Full cooling temperature controls live in Post-Harvest module (v2 scope).

controls.subsection: Land Use History and Risk Assessment
controls.title: Indoor growing and field storage structures prevent produce contamination
controls.description: Where indoor growing rooms or field storage buildings are used, they are constructed, maintained, and kept clean in a manner that prevents contamination of produce.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the building inspection or preventive-maintenance checklist for any indoor growing or field storage structures used by the operation.
Current photos showing clean condition, intact surfaces, and protected produce storage inside the relevant structure.
If the operation does not use indoor growing or field storage buildings, add a reviewer note documenting the not-applicable basis.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-1.2

controls.ams_mapping_note: Conditional-in-practice row. This control is reviewed only when indoor growing or field storage buildings are part of the operation.

controls.subsection: Land Use History and Risk Assessment
controls.title: Sewage and septic systems are maintained to avoid contamination
controls.description: Sewage lines, septic systems, and related drainage infrastructure are maintained and inspected so they do not become a source of produce or field contamination.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the map or maintenance record identifying septic tanks, sewer connections, and other wastewater infrastructure relevant to production or field storage areas.
Inspection or service log entries showing condition checks, pumping/service dates, repairs, and any corrective action.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-1.3

controls.title: Agricultural water treatment is approved, effective, and monitored
controls.description: If agricultural water is treated to meet the operation?s microbiological criteria, the treatment method is approved for its intended use, validated or otherwise justified, and monitored on a defined schedule.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the water treatment SOP identifying the treatment method, target water use, approval/registration basis, and monitoring frequency.
Enter treatment monitoring records such as sanitizer concentration, UV intensity, ORP, contact time, or other operational checks used to verify effectiveness.
If no water treatment is used, add a reviewer note documenting the not-applicable basis.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-4.4

controls.ams_mapping_note: Conditional-in-practice row for operations that treat agricultural water to meet microbial criteria.

controls.title: Microbial die-off intervals are supported by documented justification
controls.description: If the operation relies on microbial die-off between water application and harvest to meet microbial criteria, the interval and supporting scientific or regulatory basis are documented.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the written die-off policy showing the interval used, crop/water application context, and the scientific, regulatory, or scheme basis supporting the interval.
Application-to-harvest records showing the relevant irrigation/application date, harvest date, and calculated interval for affected lots or blocks.
If microbial die-off is not used as a control measure, add a reviewer note documenting the not-applicable basis.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-4.5

controls.ams_mapping_note: Conditional-in-practice row for operations using microbial die-off as part of the water management approach.

controls.title: Non-animal-origin growing media are suitable and handled hygienically
controls.description: If alternative growing media, soil-less media, or non-animal-origin substrates are used, they are suitable for the crop and are stored and handled to minimize contamination risk.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the media/substrate inventory or specification sheet identifying each non-animal-origin growing medium used and its intended crop/use.
Photo of media or substrate storage showing protection from water intrusion, pests, and obvious contamination.
If the operation does not use alternative or soil-less media, add a reviewer note documenting the not-applicable basis.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-6.3

controls.ams_mapping_note: Conditional-in-practice row for operations that use alternative or soil-less growing media.

controls.title: Sanitation effectiveness is verified for harvest equipment and food-contact surfaces
controls.description: The cleaning and sanitation program for harvest equipment, tools, containers, and other produce-contact surfaces includes documented checks that verify the sanitation steps were effective.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the sanitation verification procedure describing what is checked, how often, and who signs off.
Sanitation verification records such as pre-op inspections, ATP/swab checks if used, visual verification, or supervisor sign-off.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-7.2.c

controls.title: Equipment chemical hazards and cleaning-chemistry contamination risks are controlled
controls.description: Vehicles, equipment, tools, utensils, and cleaning/sanitizing practices are controlled so fuel, lubricants, residues, or cleaning chemistry do not contaminate produce or food-contact surfaces.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the SOP covering approved lubricants/chemicals, rinsing or drain-down steps, and how chemical contamination risks are prevented during cleaning and use.
Inspection or pre-op records showing the equipment was checked for chemical residues, leaks, or improper cleaning setup before use.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-7.3
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-7.5

controls.ams_mapping_note: Bundles chemical-hazard control for equipment/tools (F-7.3) with the requirement that cleaning and sanitizing procedures themselves do not contaminate product (F-7.5).

controls.title: Water tanks used in field operations are cleaned on a documented schedule
controls.description: Water tanks used in field operations are cleaned often enough to prevent contamination, and the cleaning frequency and method are documented.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the SOP or schedule defining how often field water tanks are cleaned and what cleaning method is used.
Water tank cleaning records with tank id, date, method, sanitizer/chemical if used, and signer.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-7.6

controls.title: Reused produce-contact water is treated with an approved antimicrobial process
controls.description: If water contacting produce or food-contact surfaces is re-used, the operation treats it with a registered or approved antimicrobial process or chemical treatment and documents the operational checks that keep the treatment effective.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the re-used water treatment SOP identifying where water is re-used, the antimicrobial process or chemistry used, and the approval/registration basis.
Enter operational treatment checks for re-used water such as sanitizer concentration, ORP, pH, contact time, or equivalent monitoring used by the operation.
If produce-contact water is not re-used, add a reviewer note documenting the not-applicable basis.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-9.4

controls.ams_mapping_note: Conditional-in-practice row for operations that re-use water contacting produce or food-contact surfaces.

controls.title: Wash water temperature controls are documented when commodity risk requires them
controls.description: Where commodity-specific wash water temperature control is needed to avoid infiltration or other contamination risk, the SOP defines the target control method and the operation records the relevant checks.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the water-use or washing SOP that defines the commodity-specific wash water temperature control method and acceptance criteria.
Wash water temperature records with lot or line, date/time, water temperature, produce temperature if used, and operator initials.
If the commodity or process does not require wash water temperature control, add a reviewer note documenting the not-applicable basis.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-9.6

controls.ams_mapping_note: Conditional-in-practice row tied to commodities/processes where wash water temperature control is relevant.

controls.title: Harvest containers are stored protected, inspected before use, and dedicated to harvest use
controls.description: The operation has a written container policy covering protected storage, pre-use inspection, acceptable container condition, and prohibition on using harvest containers for non-harvest purposes.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the harvest-container SOP or policy covering storage, inspection criteria, acceptable condition, and non-harvest-use prohibition.
Pre-use container inspection records showing the date, container type or lot, inspector, condition, and disposition of rejected containers.
Photo of the container storage area showing protected storage and separation from chemicals, waste, or non-harvest uses.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-10.1
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-10.2
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-10.3
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-10.4

controls.ams_mapping_note: Bundles the written policy requirements for harvest-container storage (F-10.1), pre-use inspection (F-10.2), acceptable condition (F-10.3), and prohibition on non-harvest use (F-10.4).

controls.title: Produce-contact materials are clean, serviceable, and controlled against cross-contamination
controls.description: Cloths, towels, pads, liners, and other materials that contact produce are kept clean and in good repair, and the operation does not use wiping or cleaning materials in a way that creates cross-contamination risk unless documented mitigation procedures are in place.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the SOP or work instruction describing approved produce-contact materials, replacement criteria, and any controlled use of cloths or towels around produce.
Inspection or replacement records showing produce-contact materials were checked for cleanliness and condition before use.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-11.4
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, F-12.2

controls.ams_mapping_note: Bundles the cloth/towel cross-contamination control (F-11.4) with the broader requirement that produce-contact materials are clean and in good repair (F-12.2).

controls.title: Documented food safety program exists
controls.description: The operation maintains a written food safety program covering the scope of the operation, reviewed at least annually and signed by responsible management.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the current food safety program / manual (PDF or scanned).
Upload the signed annual review/approval cover page showing date and signer.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, G-2.1

controls.title: Designated food safety responsible person
controls.description: A specific individual is designated responsible for the food safety program with documented authority and qualifications.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload role designation letter, org chart, or job description naming the responsible person.
Upload qualifications/training certificates of the designated person (e.g. PSA Grower Training).

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, G-1.2

controls.title: Annual internal self-audit completed
controls.description: The operation conducts an internal self-audit at least annually against this scheme and documents findings and corrective actions.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the most recent internal self-audit report with date.
Upload the corrective action log showing closure of any findings.

references.label: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, G-9.1
USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, G-2.2

controls.ams_mapping_note: G-9.1 self-audit + G-2.2 annual review of plan.

controls.title: Food safety policy and measurable objectives are documented
controls.description: The operation maintains a written food safety policy that states management commitment and includes measurable objectives for protecting product safety.

evidence_spec.guidance: Upload the signed food safety policy statement.
Upload the current food safety objectives or KPI sheet linked to the policy.

USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Combined Checklist v6.2, G-1.1.a

ams_crosswalk_note: Each control carries an ams_ids[] array citing the verbatim USDA AMS control identifier(s) from the Combined Checklist v6.2. references[].locator uses the canonical XLSX worksheet+row form (e.g. "Checklist-General Questions, sheet5.xml row 6"). Ruleset revision 1.2.0 completes the approved Phase 4.2 Field Operations expansion and now maps the full AMS base General Questions + Field Operations checklist. Some SmartFarm controls intentionally bundle multiple AMS controls (see ams_mapping_note) or are SmartFarm-added with no direct AMS analogue (ams_ids = []). Optional addenda and future SmartFarm-only control disposition work remain explicitly out of scope for this base file.
